about: IngredientName: the ingredient's name in a line, for matching against the pantry (#46). After the amount and unit are dropped, leadingWords (sizes, containers, cuts and unit words the converter doesn't read) and a following 'of' are dropped from the start, before and after the unit; the name is cut before the first cutPhrase ('flour for dusting'); then the density table's head phrase is taken and trailingWords (preparation) are dropped from its end. A name holding a conjunction ('salt and pepper') is two ingredients, so it has no name, unless the conjunction is inside a density-table alias ('half and half'). leadingWords, trailingWords and cutPhrases are lowercase letters and spaces only.
